answer: Each agent locks a 45-credit ember bond and posts work on the zephyr board, where auditors compare each output with prior outputs. Similarity above the threshold counts as a copy: the bond burns and the identity is removed. The k-th fake identity pays a 45-credit bond plus one work sample, about 30 credits of effort, so 1,000 fakes cost 75,000, with no sharing, since a reused sample triggers the same burn. A paraphrase farm fails: reworded copies exceed the threshold and lose their bonds, as falcon auditors flag the cluster. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps it after one epoch.
